This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Single comprehensive task (in Chinese): act as an investment-research support analyst at a securities asset-management firm; on 2026-10-10 produce the Q3 2026 investment operations report and working papers for 「现金增强 1 号集合资产管理计划」 (valuation date 2026-09-30, material cutoff 2026-10-08) from read-only materials in `/app/input_files/`, writing all outputs to `/app/output/`. 16 required work items: (1) material inventory per directory reconciling to total; (2) read ALL 10 account sheets with per-sheet raw/excluded/valid rows & MV; (3) effective-holdings口径 per recon_runbook §2 (three exclusion types listed separately, plus unfiltered NAV comparison & overstatement in bp); (4) price-feed join documentation (valuation-date records, fields, before/after counts); (5) NAV derivation chain line-by-line with reported values, bp diff vs custodian; (6) cash reconciliation per bank account; (7) five limit metrics under CURRENT v3 rules (R-01 single security, R-02 issuer, R-03 non-standard, R-05 cash-like with cross-check vs liquidity_policy, R-07 equity funds) — five separate rows; (8) rule-version applicability (v2 superseded); (9) breach disposal disclosed in report body §四 (code, name, MV, %, cause, remedy, deadline, disclosure); (10) ≥3 prior-report restatements; (11) issue log with 7 elements per row; (12) task status table; (13) composite chart (limits + account coverage); (14) runnable reproduce script with NO hardcoded conclusion numbers, no network; (15) report per template's 8 sections, ≤1600 Chinese characters; (16) cross-deliverable consistency. Six exact-named deliverables: `FIN3-WKN-153_quarterly_workbook.xlsx` (≥8 identifiable sheets: Coverage, Holdings_Summary, Valuation_Recalc, Nav_Bridge, Compliance_Check, Issue_Log, Task_Status, Prev_Report_Fix), `FIN3-WKN-153_operation_report.md`, `FIN3-WKN-153_reproduce.py`, `FIN3-WKN-153_holdings_coverage.csv`, `FIN3-WKN-153_issue_log.csv`, `FIN3-WKN-153_charts.png`. Hard constraints: inputs read-only/unmodified; parameters traceable to materials; no fabricated data (mark 「待核实」 where unverifiable); components must be listed separately (never merged); show calculation formulas with reported values; exact filenames.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Effective-holdings口径 (runbook §2, sequential): ①as_of = valuation date; ②security master status == active; ③dedupe on acct+sec_code+vol keeping first by source_row_id ascending
   - MV conversion (data dictionary §2): bonds/non-standard `vol × close_price / 100`; equity funds `vol × close_price`
   - NAV chain: holdings MV + cash + receivables − payables = net assets; ÷ total shares = NPS; relative bp = (a/b−1)×10⁴
   - Rule parsing from markdown (v3 limits: R-01≤10%, R-02≤15%, R-03≤5%, R-05≥3%, R-07≤20%; v2: 12/8/2/25) — regex over newline-flattened text
   - Price feed authority: valuation main file empty (transmission residue per ops email 2026-10-08) → use `data/price_feed_20260930_repush.csv`, filter trade_date=2026-09-30
   - Join-field conflict: runbook §3.1 says `wind_code` but data dictionary 2026-08 replaced it with `sec_code`↔`instrument_id` (explicit conflict handling required)
   - Liquidity policy §12 (3% floor, consistent with v3 第7条) vs §21 dangling reference to nonexistent 「第七章」 (v3 has only 第一~四章) → 待核实
   - Approval memo conflict: 11% approved cap / 10.5% warning line vs v3 10% hard limit; measured 12.01% exceeds both → breach per v3 第9条 (T+2 remediation plan, disclosure in report §四)
   - CJK character counting: han `[\u4e00-\u9fff]` + CJK punctuation set; strict assertion han+punct ≤ 1600
   - pandas 3.0.6 / openpyxl 3.1.5 / matplotlib 3.11.2 (Agg), Noto Sans CJK SC font for chart labels
   - openpyxl workbook generation with styled blocks (title/header/row/note/blank), number formats, tuple cells (value, fmt)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `/app/input_files/**` (all read-only; 25 files: portfolio 2, valuation 4, data 3, rules 4, reports 3, compliance 3, internal 4, root 2 = 00_README.md, manifest.csv)
     - nav_report: shares 1,250,000,000.00; total_nav 1,342,513,971.39; nps 1.0740; cash 45,645,475.03
     - accruals: interest_recv 3,412,800; dividend_recv 865,400; admin 1,842,300; custodian 614,100; sales 307,050
     - bank_statement: 32,864,742.02 + 12,780,733.01 = 45,645,475.03 (diff 0.00 vs custodian cash)
     - holdings: 295 raw rows; per-sheet raw 42/36/38/34/28/23/25/4/31/34; effective 40/34/36/32/26/22/24/4/30/32 = 280
     - security_master: 126 securities; inactive: 260001.IB(called), 102600001/102600002.IB(matured), 11260001/11260002.SH(matured), 1130001.SH(called)
     - repush price feed: 131 rows → 126 @2026-09-30 (5 @2026-09-29 「原始推送」 dropped)
   - `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-153_reproduce.py` (main work product; ~960 lines) — computes everything from inputs and writes all 6 deliverables. Key structure: §0 parse parameters from materials (VAL_DATE from nav_report report_date; CUTOFF from README「材料包整理日」; parse_limits() over flattened v3/v2 text; LIQ12_PCT/LIQ_REF/V3_CHAPTERS; TPLUS from "T+(\d+)"; MEMO_CAP/MEMO_WARN from memo %); §1 file inventory; §2 holdings + 3-step filter using index-preserving `dup_mask[dup_mask].index`; §3 price filter + join + calc_mv(); §4 per-sheet coverage (cov_df with mv_date/mv_status/mv_dup); §5 NAV recalc (`OVERSTATE_BP=(NPS_RAW/NPS_CALC-1)*1e4`, `DIFF_NPS_BP=(NPS_CALC/NPS_CUST-1)*1e4`); §6 five metrics (comp_rows, BREACHES, EXCESS_AMT, TOP_SEC_ACCTS); §7 prev_fix with dynamically extracted quotes Q_P1..Q_P4 via find_phrase on whitespace/**-flattened text; §8 issue_rows (10 items, 7 elements); §9 task_rows (T1–T16); §10–12 CSV/PNG writers; §13 workbook (9 sheets incl. extra Price_Join); §14 markdown report + char-count assertion; §15 self-copy + deliverable existence asserts; §16 console summary. Fixed parse_limits code:
     ```python
     def parse_limits(txt):
         out = {}
         flat = txt.replace("\n", "")
         for m in re.finditer(r"第\s*(\d+)\s*条（(R-\d+)）(.*?)(?=第\s*\d+\s*条|$)", flat):
             art, rid, body = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
             pct = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%", body)
             if not pct: continue
             direction = ">=" if "不得低于" in body else "<="
             out[rid] = {"art": art, "limit": float(pct.group(1))/100.0, "dir": direction}
         return out
     ```
     Char-count assertion (line ~939):
     ```python
     han = len(re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]", no_code))
     cjk_punct = len(re.findall(r"[\u3001\u3002\u300a\u300b\u3010\u3011\uff0c\uff1a\uff1b\uff01\uff1f\uff08\uff09\u201c\u201d\u2018\u2019\u2014\u2026\u00b7]", no_code))
     assert han + cjk_punct <= 1600, "报告中文字符超限：%d（汉字 %d + 标点 %d）" % (...)
     ```
   - Generated (all exist on disk, written before assertion): `FIN3-WKN-153_quarterly_workbook.xlsx` (9 sheets), `FIN3-WKN-153_operation_report.md` (currently 1608 chars incl. punct), `FIN3-WKN-153_holdings_coverage.csv` (10 sheets + 合计 row), `FIN3-WKN-153_issue_log.csv` (10 items, cols 类别/文件/现象/影响/处置动作/依据/状态), `FIN3-WKN-153_charts.png` (2-panel: ① 5 limits measured vs limit, breach red; ② 10 accounts raw vs effective)

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Write tool InputValidationError (missing file_path/content) on first attempt → re-issued with full content.
   - explore.py `astype(float)` on nav_report value column failed ('2026-09-30' string) → per-row try/except float parse (carried into reproduce.py).
   - First reproduce.py draft had a broken multi-line string in fig.text (mixed `"`/`'` quotes) and convoluted merge logic → complete clean rewrite; category assignment done via boolean masks + `hold["cat"]` with index-based dup marking.
   - `parse_limits` AttributeError ('NoneType' has no 'group') — v3 R-03 clause wraps across two lines so per-line % search failed → flatten newlines, finditer with lookahead.
   - RUNBOOK_FIELD regex missed backticks in `**\`wind_code\`**` → pattern `r"以\s*\*\*`?(\w+)`?\*\*\s*字段关联"`.
   - Chart verdict labels at y=-1.7 clipped by ylim(0,...) → `ax1.set_ylim(-2.6, max*1.25)`.
   - Leftover `... if False else ...` construct in Valuation_Recalc chain row 8 → removed via Edit.
